title: Onward-Journey Reimbursement After a Short Wayfare Rides Drop-Off
content:
**Reimbursement clause.** In a wrong drop-off review on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the onward-journey reimbursement is worked out from the **Wayfare Bikes and Scooters** ride charges (Wayfare Bikes ride charges) booked for the rider on the charge date of the trip's fare charge:

- where those ride charges come to at least the full reimbursement threshold of $5.00, the reimbursement is the sum of those charges as booked;
- where some such ride was charged but the charges come to less than $5.00, the reimbursement is the flat onward-journey allowance of $3.00, in place of the charges;
- where no such ride was charged, there is no reimbursement.

## Cases (hypothetical charges on the fare charge date)

| Wayfare Bikes ride charges that day | Total | Reimbursement |
|---|---|---|
| one ride at $7.15 | $7.15 | $7.15 — the charges as booked |
| two rides at $2.50 each | $5.00 | $5.00 — exactly the threshold, so the charges as booked |
| one ride at $4.99 | $4.99 | $3.00 — the flat allowance |
| one ride at $1.20 | $1.20 | $3.00 — the flat allowance, even though it is more than the charge |
| none | — | none |

Only Wayfare Bikes ride charges dated the same day as the fare charge are read; rides on other days are not counted.
